headline: SKIL Infrastructure Limited: 10th Committee of Creditors meeting in Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process
sum: SKIL Infrastructure Limited notified the 10th CoC meeting scheduled for 25 August 2026 as part of its ongoing Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016.
implication: Repeated CoC meetings (10th iteration) signal protracted resolution negotiations; partners should monitor for evidence of plan rejection cycles, creditor class disputes, or resolution plan amendments-each triggering fresh statutory timelines and disclosure obligations.
detail: SKIL Infrastructure Limited, listed on NSE, filed a pre facto intimation with the exchange disclosing the 10th Committee of Creditors meeting scheduled for 25 August 2026. The frequency of CoC meetings (ten rounds by late August 2026) indicates a complex, multi-stakeholder resolution process with likely extensions beyond the standard 180-day CIRP window. NSE regulation requires listed companies in CIRP to intimate the exchange of all material CoC proceedings. The meeting agenda and outcomes remain undisclosed in this notice.
